text: The Manager, Connected Community, and the Management Consultant, Technology Services, will provide a presentation on the Digital Infrastructure Plan, which will guide the use of data and technology by the City of Toronto. Special attention will be paid to equity, bias, and discrimination considerations with regard to digital infrastructure. Public consultations are planned for September and October.

The Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer and Two-Spirit Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Chief Technology Officer to incorporate the Committee's feedback into the work on the Digital Infrastructure Plan.
